authoritative_decision_maker.description: The institution operating the IRB applies the membership rule, subject to oversight by the competent federal authority.

evidence_expected.description: Current roster and qualification records maintained by the institution or IRB.

authoritative_decision_maker.description: The research institution and its review committee apply the composition conditions, subject to the competent authority's powers.

evidence_expected.description: Roster, expertise, affiliation, and gender-composition records maintained for the review committee.

authoritative_decision_maker.description: The controller implements and documents safeguards, subject to review by the competent supervisory authority or court.

requirements.summary: Scientific-research processing must use appropriate safeguards for data-subject rights and freedoms, including data-minimisation measures and pseudonymisation where those purposes can be fulfilled that way.

authoritative_decision_maker.description: The applicable Union or Member State legislature supplies the route; competent supervisory authorities and courts interpret or enforce it.

requirements.summary: A claimed Article 89(2) research derogation must be grounded in an identified applicable Union or Member State law and remain within that law's necessary conditions; no such law is inferred here.
requirements.title: Law-dependent research derogation route
